title: Read-later and bookmark manager
summary: Save articles to read later, organised and searchable.
whyTempting: Everyone has 200 open tabs and good intentions.
whyItFails: Saved, never read. Users save compulsively and never return, then churn. Browser features. Reading lists and bookmarks are built into browsers. Low willingness to pay. Few pay for what feels like a utility.
whatWouldChange: Summarisation and digest delivery so the value arrives without the user returning.

attempts.notes: Acquired by Mozilla in 2017; closed in July 2025.

reasons.detail: Saved, never read: Users save compulsively and never return, then churn.
Browser features: Reading lists and bookmarks are built into browsers.
